INTRODUCTION, FIRST READING AND CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ORDER PUBLISHED BY TITLE ONLY AN ORDINANCE AUTHORIZING THE GRANTING OF A REVOCABLE LICENSE AGREEMENT FOR BOULDER BIKE SHARING LOCATIONS IN THE PUBLIC RIGHT OF WAY, ON CITY-OWNED PARCELS INCLUDING PARKS PROPERTY.

Council Member Gray moved, seconded by Karakehian to support the staff recommended option for addressing trash and food waste attractants to black bears through building community awareness and utilizing an adaptive management approach based on program success (Option One); and support the staff recommended approach to improving mountain lion awareness and communication.

Council Member Morzel moved, seconded by Karakehian to direct staff to continue with an enhanced nuisance mosquito control program that 1) targets mosquito control treatments, including more emphasis on irrigation practices and mechanical control of vegetation, to reduce complaints 2) Considers the environmental impacts of treatment decisions 3) Continues the partnership with Boulder County to reduce insecticide applications for adult mosquitoes on adjacent county properties.
Council Member Morzel moved, seconded by Ageton to suspend the rules and continue the meeting at 10:21 p.m.
Council Member Morzel moved, seconded by Appelbaum to reschedule the April 19, 2011 Council meeting to Tuesday, April 12, 2011.
Council Member Morzel moved, seconded by Appelbaum authorize the city manager to enter into an agreement with the Colorado Department of Transportation (CDOT) to accept grant No. 11-BDU-01.
Council Member Appelbaum moved, seconded by Ageton to accept the work program outline and stakeholder structure and process to develop a Capital Investment Strategy.

agenda_items.section: 1. CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.title: COLORADO AMERICAN PUBLIC WORKS ASSOCIATION AWARD RECOGNITION FOR FIVE CITY OF BOULDER PROJECTS:
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Mayor Osborne accepted five awards from the American Public Works Association (APWA), one from the Green Building Institute and one from the Colorado American Institute of Architects.

agenda_items.section: 1. CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.title: LIVE, WORK, PLAY VIDEO PRESENTATION.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Staff showed a video of the North Boulder “Nobo” area involved in a Statewide Live, Work, Play 2011 People’s Choice Award competition.

agenda_items.title: OPEN COMMENT and COUNCIL/STAFF RESPONSE
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council heard from 21 speakers regarding mobile food vendors, horses off trail, plastic bags, and SmartGrid.

agenda_items.title: CONSENT AGENDA
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved items 3A through 3C, 3E and F, 3H through 3K, and 3M and 3N; items 3D and 3G were pulled for further discussion.

agenda_items.title: CALL- UP CHECK IN
agenda_items.outcome_summary: There was no interest in calling up any items.

agenda_items.title: DIRECTION ON POLICY OPTIONS FOR THE BLACK BEAR AND MOUNTAIN LION COMPONENT OF THE URBAN WILDLIFE MANAGEMENT PLAN.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council supported the staff recommended option for addressing trash and food waste attractants to black bears through building community awareness and utilizing an adaptive management approach (Option One).

agenda_items.title: EVALUATION OF THE NUISANCE MOSQUITO CONTROL PILOT PROGRAM AND FUTURE DIRECTION OF THE PROGRAM.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council directed staff to continue with an enhanced nuisance mosquito control program targeting treatments and irrigation practices.

agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO RESCHEDULE THE APRIL 19, 2011 COUNCIL MEETING TO THURSDAY, APRIL 21, 2011 AT 6 P.M. DUE TO THE PASSOVER HOLIDAY.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council rescheduled the April 19, 2011 Council meeting to Tuesday, April 12, 2011.

agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ACCEPT A COLORADO DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION GRANT FOR AIRPORT PAVEMENT REPAIRS AND LAND PURCHASE.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council authorized the city manager to enter into an agreement with the Colorado Department of Transportation (CDOT) to accept grant No. 11-BDU-01.

agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ACCEPT THE WORK PROGRAM OUTLINE AND STAKEHOLDER STRUCTURE AND PROCESS TO DEVELOP A CAPITAL INVESTMENT STRATEGY.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council accepted the work program outline and stakeholder structure and process to develop a Capital Investment Strategy.

agenda_items.title: UPDATE ON DOME FIRE EXPENSES
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Item was removed from the agenda at the request of Commissioner Ben Pearlman.

agenda_items.section: 8. MATTERS FROM MAYOR AND MEMBERS OF COUNCIL
agenda_items.title: POTENTIAL CALL-UPS
agenda_items.outcome_summary: No action was taken on the call-up items.

agenda_items.title: PUBLIC COMMENT ON MATTERS
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Gary Barnow asked Council why Council would want to buy the land at the airport.

agenda_items.title: FINAL DECISIONS ON MATTERS
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Vote was taken on the motion to accept the work program outline and stakeholder structure and process to develop a Capital Investment Strategy. The motion carried unanimously 9:0.

agenda_items.title: ADJOURNMENT
agenda_items.outcome_summary: The meeting was adjourned at 11:20 P.M.
